title: Google's Familiar Faces AI Comes to Walmart Smart Cameras
excerpt: Google's Familiar Faces feature is now available on select budget-friendly Walmart Onn smart home cameras with a subscription.
body_html:
Google has expanded its Familiar Faces AI feature to include specific budget-friendly smart home cameras sold by Walmart. A recent Google Home update adds person-recognition capabilities to the $35 Onn Outdoor Camera Plug-In and the $77 Onn Floodlight Camera Hardwired.

To use the face detection functionality on these devices, users still need to maintain a Google Home Premium subscription. The update brings the facial recognition capability to these lower-cost hardware options, allowing the cameras to identify individuals around the home.
